jobs.title: Director of Engineering – Studio Systems
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why Roblox Studio?

Roblox Studio is the creation engine behind millions of immersive 3D experiences built by creators around the world. It serves everyone from first-time developers to large professional studios, combining a powerful real-time engine with a deeply expressive toolchain.

As creation on Roblox grows more sophisticated, Studio must continue evolving as a world-class development environment for interactive 3D experiences. That requires deep investment in the technical systems that underpin the IDE experience from scripting, debugging, architecture, and core IDE capabilities including performance.

We are looking for a leader who can raise the bar on these foundational systems and help shape the future of Studio as a high-quality, extensible, and performant creation environment. Familiarity with creator tools is important, and experience with AI-assisted creation is a plus.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Engineering for Studio Systems
to lead a critical area of Roblox Studio’s technical foundation.

In this role, you will be accountable for the architecture, execution, and long-term evolution of core systems that power Studio’s IDE and developer workflows. This includes areas such as scripting, debugging, toolchain, and core architecture that are central to making Studio powerful, reliable, and scalable for creators.

This role requires deep technical leadership, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to lead through complex architectural and organizational challenges. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in developer tools or IDE-like environments, and is comfortable leading teams working in large-scale C++ codebases.

This role will be based in our San Mateo, CA headquarters (hybrid with Tues-Thurs onsite days).

You Will

Own the technical direction and delivery of major investments across Studio’s core systems.
Lead teams working on foundational areas such as scripting, debugging, toolchain, architecture, and related developer workflows.
Set and uphold a high engineering quality bar for performance, reliability, maintainability, and extensibility.
Lead senior engineers and managers across multiple teams.
Drive alignment and execution across Studio, Engine, Product, Design, Infrastructure, and related partner teams.
Partner with executive leadership to translate long-term technical strategy into durable roadmaps and organizational plans.
Help shape Studio into a best-in-class development environment for both emerging creators and professional developers.
Contribute to the future direction of AI-assisted creation workflows where they intersect with Studio’s core systems and developer experience.

You Have

15+ years of engineering experience, including leadership of large-scale and long-lived technical systems.
Proven leadership through major architectural, tooling, or platform transitions.
Strong experience building developer tools, IDEs, editor technologies, or other sophisticated technical products.
Deep technical background in systems engineering, including substantial experience with C++.
Familiarity with creator tools and workflows, especially in game development, 3D creation, or interactive development environments.
Track record of delivering reliable, high-quality systems in complex production environments.
Strong technical judgment and the ability to communicate effectively at both deep technical and executive levels.
Experience with AI-assisted creation, intelligent tooling, or LLM-powered workflows is a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director, Platform Engineering will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of InvestCloud’s shared platform capabilities across on-prem and AWS. This role provides both technical and people leadership across environments, infrastructure, CI/CD, and platform services that support mission-critical client workloads.

You will lead a team of platform engineers and managers responsible for core platform services, AWS architecture, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), while also helping to advance our operational shift to Bangalore. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will own strategy and roadmap, but you are also expected to dive into the details, help resolve critical issues, and directly contribute to design and implementation when needed.

The Director is accountable for platform reliability, scalability, security, cost efficiency, and developer experience, partnering closely with Application Engineering, Product, Server Ops, Network, InfoSec, and Corporate Support. This is a hybrid role with regular on-site time to stay tightly aligned with Platform, Server Ops, Product, and other key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Technical Leadership

Own the multi-year platform engineering strategy and roadmap, aligned to Tech Operations, Product, and business priorities.
Define and maintain platform standards, reference architectures, and guardrails for application delivery, CI/CD, infrastructure, networking, and access.
Chair or co-chair platform architecture and change forums for high-impact initiatives, including major AWS changes, CI/CD upgrades, GitLab/Artifactory patterns, and edge and ingress models.
Evaluate and steer adoption of key platform technologies, including AWS services, GitLab, Terraform, and observability tooling, balancing reliability, security, and cost.

AWS Architecture & Cloud Platform Ownership

Lead AWS platform architecture for shared services and application workloads, including multi-account structure, landing zones, environment segmentation, shared services, centralized logging, and security.
Guide teams in designing and implementing solutions on AWS, including:
Networking: VPC, Transit Gateway, peering, routing, and security groups
Identity & Access: IAM roles, SSO integrations, and least-privilege models
Core Services: S3, RDS, caching, messaging, and related patterns
Edge & Ingress: integration with NGINX/other edge components and DNS/TLS standards

Partner with Server Ops and Network Engineering on hybrid patterns spanning on-prem data centers, Kubernetes clusters, and cloud-native services.
Work with FinOps and Finance to support capacity planning, cost visibility, and optimization for platform services.

Infrastructure as Code, Automation & CI/CD

Drive standardization on IaC frameworks, primarily Terraform, for AWS and platform components, including opinionated modules, versioning, and governance.
Ensure CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab or equivalent, support secure, consistent delivery of infrastructure and application changes across environments.
Promote automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration, and change execution, reducing manual work and operational risk.
Define and enforce patterns for configuration management, secrets management, and policy-as-code in the platform stack.

Core Platform Operations & Bangalore Acceleration

Provide leadership over core platform operations, including:
Environment lifecycle and configuration
Platform change management and runbooks
On-call integration with broader Tech Ops

Partner with regional leads to advance the operational shift to Bangalore, including:
Defining scope and ownership for Bangalore-based run/operate functions
Building repeatable workflows, documentation, and handoffs that enable follow-the-sun operations
Ensuring strong alignment between NA/EU and Bangalore teams on priorities, standards, and escalation paths

Maintain a strong incident management and post-incident review culture for platform-related issues.

Reliability, Observability & Risk Management

Set and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for key platform services.
Ensure robust observability through logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts for platform components using existing tooling stacks.
Lead response for major platform incidents, coordinating cross-team triage, remediation, and stakeholder communications.
Integrate platform engineering practices with change management and risk processes, including Jira Change Management and CAB/approval workflows.

Security, Compliance & Governance

Partner with InfoSec and Risk to embed security-by-design into platform engineering:
Access models for AWS accounts, CI/CD, artifacts, observability, and data stores
TLS/certificate lifecycle, edge security, and secure connectivity patterns
Integration of application and dependency scanning into CI/CD

Ensure platform changes and architectures meet audit, client, and regulatory expectations, including traceable approvals and evidence.
Support client security reviews, RFPs, and pentest remediation related to platform components.

People Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead and grow a high-performing Platform Engineering organization, including managers, tech leads, and senior ICs, with a focus on global alignment across the US and Bangalore.
Define org structure, roles, and succession plans that support both build and run responsibilities for the platform.
Set clear goals and expectations; conduct regular 1:1s; provide coaching, feedback, and performance management.
Act as the primary executive-level point of contact for platform topics with Tech Ops, Product, Application Engineering, and Security leadership.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences through concise updates on roadmap, incidents, and key metrics.

Experience

Required Qualifications

10+ years in platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant AWS experience.
5+ years in multi-team or multi-region leadership roles, including managing managers and/or large platform charters.
Demonstrated ownership of platform roadmaps and measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed, and/or cost.

Technical Expertise

Deep experience operating hybrid platforms spanning on-prem data centers and AWS.
Strong background with CI/CD and source control, such as GitLab, and modern deployment patterns.
Hands-on understanding of AWS networking, IAM, core data services, and edge patterns.
Proficiency with Terraform and IaC concepts at scale, including modules, state management, and promotion workflows.
Solid grasp of observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and operational telemetry for distributed systems.
Familiarity with security and compliance requirements for enterprise platforms, including access control, auditability, and segmentation.

Leadership & Collaboration

Proven ability to lead and develop distributed engineering teams, including offshore and nearshore locations.
Strong track record collaborating with Product, Application Engineering, Security, and Operations to deliver cross-cutting platform outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive-level communication.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a Director or equivalent over Platform, Cloud, or DevOps in a complex enterprise or high-growth environment.
Experience working with financial services or other regulated industries.
Familiarity with Kubernetes and container platforms, GitOps practices, and/or service mesh technologies.
Prior responsibility for Bangalore or similar offshore hubs, including building out run/operate capabilities.
Relevant certifications, such as AWS, Terraform, or Kubernetes, are a plus.

Work Model

Hybrid role with primary base in NYC or Warren, NJ.
Regular on-site collaboration days with Platform, Server Ops, Product, and Security stakeholders.
Occasional early/late calls to support collaboration with Bangalore and other regions, as needed.

About InvestCloud

InvestCloud, a global leader in wealth technology, aspires to enable a smarter financial future. Driving the digital transformation of the wealth management industry, the company serves a broad array of clients globally, including Wealth and Asset Managers, Wirehouses, Banks, RIAs, and Insurers. In terms of scale, the company’s clients represent more than 40 percent of the $132 trillion of total assets globally. As a leader in delivering personalization and scale across advisory programs, including unified managed accounts (UMA) and separately managed accounts (SMA), the company is committed to the success of its clients. By equipping and enabling advisors and their clients with connected technology, enhanced intelligence, and inspired experiences, InvestCloud delivers leading digital wealth management and financial planning solutions, complemented by a dynamic data warehouse, which scale across the complete wealth continuum. In 2024, InvestCloud was named CNBC World’s Top Fintech Company, a proof point of the company’s commitment to innovation and client success. Headquartered in the United States, InvestCloud serves clients around the world. For more information, visit InvestCloud.com.

Our Values

Client Connected
Human Centered
Technology Forward
Respect + Integrity
Excellence

The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on the applicant’s geographic location. Salary range: $200,000 - $230,000. Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, vision, disability, and life/AD&D insurance plans, Flexible Savings Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), health advocacy, voluntary ancillary plans (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, legal, identity theft, auto/home, and pet insurance), 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Director, Scale-up & Engineering
jobs.description:
Here’s What All The Hype Is About…

Premier Nutrition Company (PNC) is one of the fastest-growing companies in the proactive wellness space showing clear leadership in the category of protein shakes and powders. We make the brands Premier Protein and Dymatize , and are part of our publicly traded holding company, BellRing Brands (NYSE: BRBR).

We have a simple, yet powerful, formula for our success, which we’ve been nailing since our founding in 1997. We start with an organization powered by our company purpose— Changing Lives with Good Energy . Then our purpose-driven people are given the support and autonomy to develop and grow. Next, we are super-intentional about designing a culture where everyone feels like they truly connect and belong , which is one of our five company core values. Purpose-driven, connected employees deliver amazing business results. And winning companies with remarkable people and thriving cultures attract and retain top talent, so the cycle becomes self-reinforcing or what we call our regenerative culture .

We don’t mind sharing our formula, since we believe the world would be a better place if more workplaces treated adults like adults and gave them the platform to do the best work of their lives—alongside some truly amazing colleagues. Why don’t more companies do this? It takes deep-in-your-bones conviction to your people, products, and purpose to pull it off. It also takes resisting the urge to try to control people, and instead, trusting them to make the right decisions. The result of our vibrant culture speaks for itself: We were certified as a Great Place to Work ™ for the 9 th year-running in 2025. And we currently rank #8 on Fortune Magazine’s Best Workplaces in our category and were in the top 12 for each of the last 7 years.

We have a long list of ways we take care of our people, but here are some crowd-pleasers that our employees often say they love most: Year-round ½ day Fridays, in-office massages, free lunches & snacks, dogs in the office, culture of belonging celebrations, engaging in-office events like bring your kids to work day, 6% 401k match after 1 year, generous paid family leave regardless of gender, all positions bonus-eligible, company-wide volunteer days, company-matched charitable donations, no employee handbook, no dress code, coaching conversations instead of performance reviews, and walking meetings.

PNC seeks individuals who will flourish in this type of work environment and will add to our culture and help build this high-growth company for the next phase in our amazing journey. Does this sound like you? Then read on…

We believe in the power of mindset, and specifically what we call the Challenger Mindset . Do you take smart, bold risks, display relentless hunger, and see yourself as a builder? We’re looking for individuals who choose action over analysis paralysis—those who start before they feel completely ready, make calculated moves based on the best information available, and build momentum through decisive action rather than perfect planning. You should have an insatiable drive that keeps you agile and forward-thinking, always challenging assumptions, seeking new opportunities, and focusing on long-term impact over short-term wins. Above all, you’re a builder—someone who transforms the status quo, finds smarter, simpler, faster ways to get things done, and inspires others to do the same.

The role you’re interested in…

The successful candidate will be an experienced R&D leader who provides strategic direction and technical oversight for scale-up, process engineering, packaging engineering and manufacturing support activities. This role will lead pilot plant operations (internal and external), scale-up efforts at co-manufacturing facilities, and process and packaging improvement initiatives focused on cost optimization and operational efficiency.

The position will lead a team of 5-10 technical professionals and technicians, ensuring pilot plant, scale-up and packaging activities align with business objectives and enable a seamless transition from product/package development, through commercialization. Responsibilities include establishing robust scale-up processes, supporting manufacturing troubleshooting, and ensuring products can be efficiently and reliably produced at commercial scale.

Success in this role requires strong cross-functional leadership and shared accountability for project outcomes. The leader will build effective partnerships with internal stakeholders, co-manufacturers, and external service providers to drive projects from development through successful commercialization. This role reports into our VP, Product Development.

If you are ready to flex your thinking between technical problem solving, guiding, enhance scale up program, and coaching team members, then welcome aboard.

The work environment…

So, what’s it like to work here? If you’re based in the greater Bay Area, you’ll walk into our Emeryville office each Tuesday morning and start the in-person portion of our hybrid work week at our weekly all-company meeting and find close to 200 of your colleagues, some sitting with their dogs, talking excitedly through the week ahead and watching a newer teammate tell their personal life and career journey followed by a quick update on any hot topics that might be relevant to the week ahead.

We are a dynamic, HYBRID workplace, with an expectation that all employees come into the office Tuesday through Thursday. We are very intentional about connecting in person for things like innovation, impromptu collaboration, having respectful challenges to get to better decisions, leadership role-modeling, and culture building. Great work cultures are built on stories about what great looks like in practice, and great stories during virtual meetings just don’t happen. The expected pay scale for this role is $200k to $220k, which may vary based on relevant experience, qualifications, geographic area (if applicable), and internal equity for the role.

At the beginning of 2026, we moved into our massive modern 133,000 square foot headquarters in Emeryville, California, complete with spacious personal workspaces, gym with rock-climbing wall, a café, free onsite parking, tons of greenery, and many transportation options.

You’re excited about this opportunity because your time will be filled with…

Critical Thinking & Technical Leadership: 40% of your time

Lead scale-up, commercialization, pilot plant operations, and manufacturing support activities
Drive continuous improvement of scale-up and commercialization processes to ensure efficient transitions from development to production
Build strategic partnerships with co-manufacturers and external service providers to ensure R&D objectives are met
Oversee and integrate technical packaging activities in scale-up and commercialization initiatives
Provide technical leadership in processing, manufacturing performance, packaging engineering, risk management, and problem-solving
Ensure product, package and process compliance through collaboration with cross-functional partners
Identify emerging technologies, trends, and external capabilities to strengthen R&D and commercialization
Provide input on long-term capability, equipment, facility, and talent needs

R&I People Leadership & Culture: 40% of your time

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing technical team
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning
Manage resource allocation and priorities to ensure successful project execution
Contribute as an active member of the R&I Leadership Team
Build strong partnerships across functions and external organizations to drive project success
Represent and advocates for R&I by providing technical insight, strategic thinking, and leadership across the business

The daily stuff that everyone does but few quantify: 20% of your time

Attending meetings and presentations
Participating in company-wide activities and events galore
Impromptu conversations with colleagues
Administrivia like email, calendaring, expense reports, and other non-value-added work

What are we looking for?

Ability to explain complex technical subject matters to non-technical team
Ability to apply technical know-out to real world problems
Ability to drive results, pivot quickly as needed
Strong collaborative skills and ability to work well in teams
Possess curiosity, creativity, and alternative thinking to develop better or new solutions with a scientific approach

Education

Bachelor’s degree Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biological Sciences, Food Science or similar field

Experience

12+ years of experience in the food and beverage industry, including thermal processing and aseptic beverage processing, and high-protein RTD scale-up.
5+ years of people leadership experience managing technical teams.
Demonstrated success commercializing products (product, process, package) through co-manufacturing partners and supporting manufacturing operations.
Strong technical troubleshooting and process optimization capabilities.
Working knowledge (incl. Mechanical) of processing and packaging equipment and manufacturing systems (batching through packaging)
Strong working knowledge of process capability studies, statistical process control and specifications – ability to read, design and interpret specifications

Skills And Mindset

Strong ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across all levels of external manufacturing organizations
Ability to translate complex technical information into clear business recommendations and drive decision-making
Proven cross-functional leadership and project management skills with a track record of delivering results through internal and external teams
Demonstrated experience managing project risk, solving complex technical challenges, and executing against timelines
Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
Willingness to travel up to 35%

What The Work Is Like

You'll spend a significant portion of your day working on a computer, reviewing data, creating reports, communicating with partners, and joining virtual and in-person meetings
This role requires frequent and ongoing use of a keyboard, mouse, phone, and other office technology
You'll regularly navigate multiple systems at once, analyze detailed information, and shift between competing priorities and deadlines
You'll communicate regularly with team members, cross-functional partners, external partners, and leaders through meetings, Outlook based email, messaging platforms such as Microsoft Teams, and presentations
Occasional movement around the office may be required for meetings, collaboration, and team activities
May occasionally lift or move office materials weighing up to 10 pounds

So, if after reading through this long list you’re thinking—I’m not sure I meet 100% of these requirements, should I still apply? YES—if you embody a growth mindset, see challenges as opportunities to develop, and find innovative ways to get the real work that matters done, you sound like our kind of candidate!

The 5 capabilities or mindsets most relevant to this role:

Emotional intelligence
Thrive in ambiguity amid competing priorities
Connect & Belong
Play to Win
Creativity, exploration, & innovativeness

You will thrive here and may just do the best work of your life if…

You want to be an integral part of shaping and nurturing an amazing work culture
You can be flexible in your approach to challenges and abandon past practices if they don’t make sense or lead to a poor outcome
You are comfortable being natural, casual, open, and even a bit playful at work
You don’t have a big ego and hate siloed thinking
You can be friendly, vulnerable, and self-deprecating in one moment, and deal with a challenging, delicate people-related matter as a professional in the next

WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

Role Overview:

As the Head of Identity & Data Platform, you will own and evolve one of the most critical layers of Zeta’s platform—the systems that power identity resolution, data ingestion, enrichment, and activation. You will lead a 50–60+ person engineering organization and define the long-term strategy for how identity and data power AI-native applications across the company.
This is a highly strategic and technical leadership role requiring deep domain expertise in identity management, strong organizational leadership, and the ability to operate at both architectural and executive levels. You will directly report to the EVP & Head of Engineering.

Lead and inspire a team of ~50 engineers,
Own the evolution of identity resolution and identity graph systems, advancing deterministic and probabilistic matching, cross-channel identity, and real-time enrichment as core competitive capabilities.
Drive the evolution
Collaborate cross-functionally with AI, marketing, and product teams to ensure seamless integration of identity services across Zeta’s platform.
Establish the data layer as the context engine for Zeta’s AI-native platform, enabling real-time features, embeddings, and data access for models, agents, and downstream applications.
Benchmark against industry leaders and innovate ahead of the market in identity solutions.
Ensure compliance with privacy and data governance standards (e.g., CCPA, GDPR).
Recruit, mentor, and develop top talent, while creating a strong succession plan for critical roles.
Partner with executive leadership on strategy, investment, and prioritization, aligning platform evolution with business outcomes and long-term scalability.
Collaborate with DevEx and AI Enablement teams to drive adoption of AI-native engineering practices across the data layer, improving developer productivity, code quality, and system evolution velocity.

Qualifications:

12+ years of engineering leadership, including significant time leading large-scale identity or data platforms.
Deep domain expertise in identity resolution, identity graphs, and data enrichment—preferably with experience from a top competitor or parallel industry.
Understand applicability, pros & cons & effectiveness of data engineering design patterns & concepts such as Data Lakehouse, Data Table Format, Zero-Copy Data Sharing, Cleanroom, Real-Time vs Batch Data Processing, High throughput distributed system APIs
Possess experience working on data technologies equivalent to: Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
Iceberg, Hudi, Delta
EMR, Airflow, Spark
Aerospike, Scylla, DynamoDB

jobs.title: VP, Functional Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Functional Design Engineering is where enterprise architecture intent becomes shippable Terraform. At LPL, you'll partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and FinOps to translate big-picture designs into opinionated, well-architected reference patterns that engineers actually build. If you'd rather spend your time turning architects' diagrams into code, ADRs, and proof-of-concept platforms — and want a senior leadership role where you're as comfortable in a design review as you are in a pull request — this is your seat.

Job Overview:

As the VP, Functional Design Engineering, you lead the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and engineering teams and pods across CCOE to translate enterprise architecture intent into implementable, well-architected, code-driven solutions. You take high-level designs from architects and produce detailed, opinionated, build-ready engineering specifications aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework and LPL's standards. You also curate the cross-CCOE reference pattern library — domain-tagged Terraform module bundles, reference architectures, anti-patterns, and architecture decision records (ADRs). LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You are both a people leader for a small, senior team across the US and LPL's India GCC and a hands-on senior engineer who produces reference patterns, code, and proof-of-concept builds when ambiguity is highest.

Responsibilities:

Lead the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod within the Foundations team in CCOE; partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, the other Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and the Platforms, Containers, Support, and Delivery teams to translate enterprise architecture intent into implementable, well-architected, code-driven solutions
Take high-level designs from architects and produce detailed, opinionated, build-ready engineering specifications aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework and LPL standards
Define and curate the cross-CCOE reference pattern library: domain-tagged Terraform module bundles, reference architectures, anti-patterns, and architecture decision records (ADRs)
Partner closely with the Principal Engineer, Cloud Strategy Lead so that tooling, IaC, and self-service platform strategy stay aligned with enterprise design direction
Lead design reviews, architecture review boards, and engineering deep-dives across all five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the four peer Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Network Engineering, Monitoring)
Champion the application of the AWS Well-Architected Framework across all six pillars (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability) and drive measurable improvements against each
Hands-on contribute to reference patterns, Terraform modules, and proof-of-concept builds, especially in the highest-ambiguity areas where engineering is still discovering the right answer
Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
Embed agentic AI capabilities into the design function: AI-assisted pattern generation, automated Well-Architected reviews, ADR drafting, cross-pattern impact analysis, and MCP-backed agents that surface existing patterns to internal customers
Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain a globally distributed team of senior cloud engineers across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC)

Opportunity

Adapture Renewables, Inc. is on a mission to be a leader in this new era of sustainable energy. Drawing upon an extensive knowledge base, we develop, finance, engineer, build, own, and operate high quality utility-scale photovoltaic projects and battery energy storage projects. Overview

This position will work in our Engineering team and report to the Sr. Director of Engineering. The Director of Optimization Engineering owns the technical strategy for optimizing our hybrid and collocated utility-scale solar and battery energy storage (BESS) systems — driving energy production, capture, storage efficiency, and load-matching across Adapture Renewable’s multi-GW development pipeline. This is a builder’s seat: the role sets the optimization vision, defines success criteria, and grows a team of engineers to execute against it, partnering closely with Development, Interconnection & Transmission, Asset Management, and Power Marketing. The candidate will ideally be based in the San Francisco Bay Area (hybrid); remote considered for exceptional candidates.

Core Responsibilities

Own the engineering roadmap for hybrid solar-plus-storage optimization — from system sizing and configuration through dispatch strategy — and define the KPIs and initiatives that connect design choices to energy yield and financial return.
Govern PV performance modeling standards (PVSyst), including P50/P90 production estimates, degradation profiles, and loss/availability frameworks.
Model and optimize combined PV and BESS output to serve large-load customers such as data centers, through both front-of-meter and co-located behind-the-meter designs.
Set the engineering basis for battery dispatch and energy-arbitrage strategy using linear-programming methods, in coordination with Power Marketing.
Establish standards for solar/BESS sizing, EMS configuration, DC/AC ratios, ground coverage ratios, state-of-charge limits, and round-trip efficiency.
Ensure designs meet utility and interconnection requirements and SCADA/EMS protocols; partner with Interconnection & Transmission and IT on the underlying data path.
Direct root-cause analysis of operating-fleet underperformance (soiling, availability, equipment faults, clipping, degradation, capacity fade) and feed findings back into design and procurement.
Hire, develop, and lead the optimization engineering team, including the Manager of Optimization Engineering.
Deliver design and performance recommendations to Engineering leadership and, as needed, to ownership.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, energy, or systems engineering, or an equivalent quantitative discipline; advanced degree a plus.
8+ years in renewable energy, with hands-on experience designing and optimizing utility-scale solar and demonstrated BESS experience (sizing, dispatch optimization, degradation, or performance modeling).
3+ years leading and developing technical teams, with a track record of setting vision and delivering results.
Deep fluency in PV performance modeling (PVSyst or equivalent), including P50/P90 yield estimation and loss/availability analysis.
Strong PV and BESS electrical engineering foundation: inverters and DC/AC conversion, EMS configuration, state-of-charge limits, and round-trip efficiency.
Working command of dispatch/arbitrage optimization (linear programming or comparable methods) and the data analytics behind battery control strategies.
Proven ability to translate models and data into prioritized, economically grounded recommendations for engineers, executives, and owners.
Preferred: Python (SciPy or similar solvers), MATLAB, and SQL; SCADA/EMS and OT data architecture experience; familiarity with BESS warranty and capacity-guarantee structures; working knowledge of interconnection and market context (PPA structures, curtailment, ancillary services); PE license a plus.
Ability to travel occasionally to project sites and the Bay Area office.

Work-from-home policy
Salary commensurate with experience, range $200,000 - $245,000

Position Summary

We are seeking a senior, hands-on Performance Engineering Sr. QA Manager (M3) to lead a Performance Engineering Center of Excellence and own QA delivery for a product portfolio supporting high-transaction healthcare platforms. This role is ideal for a technical leader who can improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of EMR/EHR systems while mentoring strong QA teams and influencing engineering decisions with data. The candidate will shape performance strategy, build realistic workload models, diagnose complex bottlenecks, leverage observability, guide tooling architecture, and strengthen QA processes, quality metrics, and release readiness across systems built on microservices, APIs, cloud-native platforms, and modern frontend architectures.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Performance Engineering CoE by defining performance standards, reusable frameworks, tooling strategy, governance practices, and enablement models that scale across product lines.
Design realistic workload models, performance baselines, SLAs, and regression thresholds using production metrics, usage analytics, clinical transaction patterns, concurrency targets, throughput goals, and data volumes.
Plan and execute load, stress, spike, soak, capacity, and scalability testing for high-volume workflows, then translate results into clear engineering recommendations and remediation priorities.
Partner with development, architecture, DevOps, and database teams to identify and resolve bottlenecks across APIs, JVM, databases, caching, frontend, network, infrastructure, and cloud layers.
Define automation coverage targets, guide scalable frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, or equivalent tools, and use coverage thresholds as part of release quality gates.
Establish and track quality metrics across performance, scalability, reliability, security, accessibility, environment stability, release confidence, defect escape rate, and other non-functional requirements.
Lead release readiness and QA governance reviews with clear entry and exit criteria, test strategy alignment, go/no-go recommendations, defect triage discipline, test evidence, release process adherence, and transparent risk communication.
Improve QA productivity by reducing test cycle time, increasing defect detection efficiency, improving MTTR, strengthening sprint predictability, stabilizing environments, and reducing flaky automation.
Partner with product, engineering, architecture, DevOps, and QA leaders during planning, design reviews, defect triage, release readiness, and product discussions to surface risks early and influence decisions with data.
Support the Testing CoE by sharing reusable frameworks, standards, automation assets, lessons learned, and best practices that raise quality maturity across the organization.

12+ years of progressive Quality Engineering and/or Performance Engineering experience, including 4+ years in formal people management or engineering leadership roles managing QA teams of five or more engineers.
Ability to personally design, script, execute, analyze, and communicate performance tests and findings without relying solely on team execution.
Hands-on experience with JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, Gatling, NeoLoad, or equivalent tools, including advanced scripting, protocol-level testing, workload modeling, distributed load generation, correlation, and parameterization.
Ability to program and script in Java, Groovy, Python, or equivalent languages to build test scripts, utilities, custom extensions, and automation support.
Strong working knowledge of modern distributed architectures, including microservices, APIs, API gateways, event-driven systems, containers, Java Spring Boot services, and React-based frontend or micro-frontend applications.
Experience integrating quality and performance validation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms, with automated execution, pipeline reporting, performance gates, and release thresholds.
Strong understanding of system performance tuning across JVM internals, garbage collection, thread analysis, connection pools, application server configuration, OS and infrastructure utilization, and autoscaling behavior.
Practical experience with Dynatrace or comparable APM tools, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, proactive monitoring, and performance analysis across Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, query tuning, and indexing.
Strong troubleshooting capability across application code, JVM, database, network, infrastructure, and frontend layers, with the ability to translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations.

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted QA, test automation, code generation, analysis, or productivity tools to improve test coverage, delivery speed, engineering effectiveness, and quality outcomes.

Healthcare technology, EMR, EHR, clinical workflow, patient-facing platform, or other mission-critical healthcare product experience.
Experience building or scaling a Performance Engineering CoE, community of practice, shared tooling library, governance model, or internal enablement program.
Experience with Kubernetes, container resource tuning, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Regular collaboration with distributed engineering, QA, and DevOps teams across US and India time zones; the ability to communicate effectively across geographies and lead virtual teams is essential to success in this role.

new_jobs.description:
Opportunity

Adapture Renewables, Inc. is on a mission to be a leader in this new era of sustainable energy. Drawing upon an extensive knowledge base, we develop, finance, engineer, build, own, and operate high quality utility-scale photovoltaic projects and battery energy storage projects. Our Engineering team is looking for a talented Director of Optimization Engineering to help support the efforts of our fast-growing company. Adapture Renewables is owned by KIRKBI – the private holding and investment company of the Kirk Kristiansen family founded to build a sustainable future for the LEGO® brand through generations.

Overview

This position will work in our Engineering team and report to the Sr. Director of Engineering. The Director of Optimization Engineering owns the technical strategy for optimizing our hybrid and collocated utility-scale solar and battery energy storage (BESS) systems — driving energy production, capture, storage efficiency, and load-matching across Adapture Renewable’s multi-GW development pipeline. This is a builder’s seat: the role sets the optimization vision, defines success criteria, and grows a team of engineers to execute against it, partnering closely with Development, Interconnection & Transmission, Asset Management, and Power Marketing. The candidate will ideally be based in the San Francisco Bay Area (hybrid); remote considered for exceptional candidates.

Core Responsibilities

Own the engineering roadmap for hybrid solar-plus-storage optimization — from system sizing and configuration through dispatch strategy — and define the KPIs and initiatives that connect design choices to energy yield and financial return.
Govern PV performance modeling standards (PVSyst), including P50/P90 production estimates, degradation profiles, and loss/availability frameworks.
Model and optimize combined PV and BESS output to serve large-load customers such as data centers, through both front-of-meter and co-located behind-the-meter designs.
Set the engineering basis for battery dispatch and energy-arbitrage strategy using linear-programming methods, in coordination with Power Marketing.
Establish standards for solar/BESS sizing, EMS configuration, DC/AC ratios, ground coverage ratios, state-of-charge limits, and round-trip efficiency.
Ensure designs meet utility and interconnection requirements and SCADA/EMS protocols; partner with Interconnection & Transmission and IT on the underlying data path.
Direct root-cause analysis of operating-fleet underperformance (soiling, availability, equipment faults, clipping, degradation, capacity fade) and feed findings back into design and procurement.
Hire, develop, and lead the optimization engineering team, including the Manager of Optimization Engineering.
Deliver design and performance recommendations to Engineering leadership and, as needed, to ownership.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, energy, or systems engineering, or an equivalent quantitative discipline; advanced degree a plus.
8+ years in renewable energy, with hands-on experience designing and optimizing utility-scale solar and demonstrated BESS experience (sizing, dispatch optimization, degradation, or performance modeling).
3+ years leading and developing technical teams, with a track record of setting vision and delivering results.
Deep fluency in PV performance modeling (PVSyst or equivalent), including P50/P90 yield estimation and loss/availability analysis.
Strong PV and BESS electrical engineering foundation: inverters and DC/AC conversion, EMS configuration, state-of-charge limits, and round-trip efficiency.
Working command of dispatch/arbitrage optimization (linear programming or comparable methods) and the data analytics behind battery control strategies.
Proven ability to translate models and data into prioritized, economically grounded recommendations for engineers, executives, and owners.
Preferred: Python (SciPy or similar solvers), MATLAB, and SQL; SCADA/EMS and OT data architecture experience; familiarity with BESS warranty and capacity-guarantee structures; working knowledge of interconnection and market context (PPA structures, curtailment, ancillary services); PE license a plus.
Ability to travel occasionally to project sites and the Bay Area office.

Benefits Package

401(k) plan with company matching contribution
Competitive health, vision, and dental benefits
Attractive personal time off and company holiday package
Work-from-home policy
Salary commensurate with experience, range $200,000 - $245,000
